summary: InterCure Ltd. filed a Form 6-K disclosing a private placement of 1,579,028 units, each comprising one ordinary share and a five-year warrant with an exercise price of $1.59, at $2.918 per unit. Gross proceeds totaled $5 million, excluding approximately $2 million from CEO and Chairman Alexander Rabinovich, whose 26% beneficial ownership required shareholder approval for his participation. Proceeds are earmarked for working capital and rehabilitating the Nir Oz facility of subsidiary Canndoc Ltd. The offering was exempt under Section 4(a)(2) and Regulation S. Watch for shareholder approval and potential dilution impact.
